svg.aria-label: Loss against the dataset step, from 0 to 4,000. The training loss of the four nodes, smoothed, falls from 11.0 together, to about 3.65 at step 4,000. The official Pythia-14M checkpoints, scored on a held-out batch, go from 11.006 at step 0 to 6.184 at step 512, 5.151 at 1,000, 4.115 at 2,000, 3.878 at 3,000 and 3.781 at 4,000. This run's committed rounds, on the same batch, score 10.303 at step 64, 6.346 at about 480, then below the official curve from about step 1,200, down to 3.618 at step 4,000. Nine PolyPythia seeds score 3.732 to 3.762 at step 4,000.
